hypothesis: Y051 established complementary fixed-schedule risks, while Y052 failed to learn future shock timing from identical preshock observations. A preregistered balanced 50/50 allocation across the two existing schedules can reduce the worst-case aggregate shock-onset loss across independent runs without predicting any future event or consuming extra landmark reads per run. It may increase pooled mean error relative to the best single fixed arm.
freeze: Freeze two exact Y051 schedules A0/1/3/5/7 and B0/1/3/4/6, deterministic exogenous balanced schedule allocation A for even seed and B for odd seed (8 of each in the 16-seed heldout cohort per affine family/policy/onset), 4 new affine families, five original onset classes, all controls and criteria prior to first use.
arms: fixed_A: every trial uses schedule A, ten public landmark readings
fixed_B: every trial uses schedule B, same ten readings

hedged_50_50: choose fixed A for even seed and B for odd seed BEFORE any episode; allocation is external one-bit schedule randomization keyed by fresh synthetic trial seed, not a learned or reactive controller
primary: Measure total assignment mismatches by shock onset and each arm relative to same-arm matched canonical controls. Define worst-case shock-onset aggregate loss=max errors across onset4..7 and pooled loss=sum onset4..7. PORTFOLIO_WORST_CASE_GAIN iff hedge max<=0.75*min(max(A),max(B)), pooled hedge<=1.10*min(pooled(A),pooled(B)), every steady arm=0, each arm exactly ten public landmark scalars per 8 episodes. PARETO_PARTIAL if hedge max<=0.90*min and pooled<=1.20*min with steady zero. NO_GAIN otherwise. Preserve per-seed winners/losers, policy regimes, churn and reads.
controls: Interleaving or schedule diversification is across independent trial instances, NOT a within-instance adaptive probe policy; random bit/synthetic trial ID is an allocation mechanism and counts as extra one-bit control metadata
Matched fixed schedules A/B evaluated on exact same seeds, families, regimes and policies. Each trial sees exactly five pairs of publicly observable landmarks, 7 active/9 cached/16 total unchanged
No privileged shock onset is passed into chosen schedule. Candidate is irrevocably selected before episode0 and no hidden future events or per-world oracle are used

Exact pinned Y051/Y050 evaluator; original first-use evidence and final full pytest, no first-use rerun, post-outcome threshold change, science acceptance, accepted-ref mutation or production authority
claim_limit: Synthetic trial-population schedule diversification at equal landmark-sensing cost, not within-run adaptation, event prediction, or biological regenerative intelligence.
